description: FREE preview scan of a target MCP server for tool-poisoning / prompt-injection. Returns issue count, severity breakdown, risk score, and verdict (clear/review/block) — but NOT which tools or the evidence. Use this to check any MCP server (including your own) at no cost; if issues are found, call the paid scan_mcp_server for the itemized findings + remediation. No payment required.
